The author is known as a postmodernist.

Many postmodernists question traditional ideas of truth.
許多後現代主義者質疑傳統的真理觀。
His fear of dogs is deeply rooted in childhood.
他對狗的恐懼深植於童年。
The tree is firmly rooted in the ground.
這棵樹牢牢地紮根在土裡。
The child felt shy about his nakedness.
那個孩子對自己赤身裸體感到害羞。
The painting celebrates the nakedness of the human body.
這幅畫呈現人體的裸露之美。
Several bigwigs from the company attended the dinner.
公司幾位大人物出席了晚宴。
He became a political bigwig in the town.
他成了鎮上有分量的政界要角。
Doves coo softly in the morning.
鴿子在早晨輕輕地咕咕叫。
She cooed to the baby until he fell asleep.
她輕聲對寶寶說話，直到他睡著。

malleable.zh: 有延展性的；易受影響的
ai: Gold is a soft, malleable metal.
黃金是一種柔軟、有延展性的金屬。
Young minds are malleable and easily influenced.
年輕人的心智可塑性高，容易受影響。
The movie is about a zombie apocalypse.
這部電影講的是殭屍末日。
Some people believe the apocalypse is near.
有些人相信世界末日近了。
Dark clouds portend a coming storm.
烏雲預示暴風雨即將來臨。
The sudden drop in sales may portend trouble.
銷售量驟降可能預示著麻煩。
Lying under oath is an impeachable offense.
宣誓後說謊是可被彈劾的罪行。
The law lists several impeachable acts.
法律列出了數種可被彈劾的行為。
I found the lecture long and uninteresting.
我覺得那場演講又長又無趣。
He told an uninteresting story about his trip.
他講了一個關於旅行的乏味故事。
I decided to splurge on a nice dinner.
我決定奢侈一下，吃頓好的晚餐。
They splurged on a trip to Japan.
他們豁出去花錢去了趟日本。
The new phone was a big splurge for me.
這支新手機對我來說是一筆大花費。
A weekend spa trip is a nice splurge.
週末去做水療是一種不錯的犒賞花費。

unaided.zh: 沒有協助的、未借助外力的
ai: He climbed the stairs unaided.
他不靠旁人協助自己爬上樓梯。
Stars can be seen with the unaided eye.
用肉眼就能看見星星。
We drove along a narrow, tortuous mountain road.
我們沿著狹窄蜿蜒的山路開車。
The tortuous process took months to complete.
這個迂迴曲折的過程花了好幾個月才完成。
She smiled and showed her pearly white teeth.
她微笑時露出珍珠般潔白的牙齒。
The shell had a soft, pearly shine.
這個貝殼泛著柔和的珍珠光澤。
The box is watertight and keeps the phone dry.
這個盒子防水，能讓手機保持乾燥。
The lawyer presented a watertight argument.
律師提出了一個無懈可擊的論點。
It was a gutsy move to quit her job and start a business.
辭職創業是個很有膽量的決定。
The team put on a gutsy performance.
球隊展現了一場有魄力的表現。
The seer warned the king about the coming war.
先知向國王警告即將來臨的戰爭。
In the legend, a blind seer could see the future.
傳說中，一位盲眼的預言者能看見未來。
The speechwriter spent days polishing the address.
這位講稿撰寫人花了好幾天修飾這篇演說。
She works as a speechwriter for a mayor.
她擔任一位市長的演講稿撰寫人。
The castle stood magnificently on the hill.
城堡雄偉壯麗地矗立在山丘上。
The choir sang magnificently last night.
合唱團昨晚唱得精彩極了。
The tracer helped them follow the package.
這個追蹤器幫助他們追蹤包裹。
Tracer bullets glow so soldiers can see where they go.
曳光彈會發光，讓士兵看見它的軌跡。
She puckered her lips to blow out the candle.
她噘起嘴唇吹熄蠟燭。
The sour lemon made his face pucker.
酸檸檬讓他整張臉皺了起來。
The machinist adjusted the lathe carefully.
機械工小心地調整車床。
He trained for years to become a machinist.
他受訓多年才成為機械工。
She is a likeable person and easy to talk to.
她是個討人喜歡的人，很好聊天。
The hero of the show is a likeable fool.
這部劇的主角是個討喜的傻瓜。
The villain in the story was a lying scoundrel.
故事中的壞人是個說謊的惡棍。
That scoundrel stole money from his own family.
那個無賴竟偷了自己家人的錢。
